blocks.content: If the node to be deleted is red, we can simply delete it as we do in BST.
Deletion of a red node cannot violate any red-black property.

items: Leaf Property: The leaf nodes are always black NIL nodes. So, deleting a red node will not violate them.
Root Property: The root node is black. So, deleting a red node will not affect it.
Red Node Property: Deleting a red node cannot violate red-node property.
Black Depth Property: Again, deleting a red node cannot affect the count of black nodes.

blocks.content: So, for the deletion of a red node, simple BST deletion is sufficient.
